messages.speaker: Professor Chen
messages.text: Second protocol. The creature has hatched, but it refuses to drift away from your heartbeat. We are testing what it does when your bond is challenged.

messages.speaker: Professor Chen
messages.text: A simulation opens the room door. An unknown signal calls the creature from the corridor while our security locks begin to close.

choices.label: I pin the creature close to me and regain control of the room.
I speak softly so it can feel that I am staying with it.
I let it watch the corridor so I can understand what attracts it.

messages.speaker: Professor Chen
messages.text: The creature modulates its skin according to your decision. It is not only obeying: it interprets your intention before you even move.

choices.label: I secure the perimeter first. Nothing leaves the laboratory.
I compare the signal to its reactions and look for a pattern.
I move forward with it to see if the signal comes from another organism.

messages.speaker: Professor Chen
messages.text: Final sequence. The creature mirrors your breathing, but it also begins to resist the protocol. It is looking for a direction that is not only yours.

choices.label: I set a clear limit: it must survive without threatening the team.
I protect its autonomy, even if the protocol becomes harder to control.
I follow the signal with it to discover what the lab cannot see.
